input.command: source generators/blender.pin && echo "$BLENDER_SHA256  $BLENDER_CACHE/blender-4.5.3-linux-x64.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c - && "$BLENDER_CACHE/$BLENDER_DIR/blender" --version | head -2 && cat /etc/os-release | grep -E "^(NAME|VERSION)="
input.description: Verify Blender archive SHA and binary version, print OS
